rationale: PO-4422 is a SERVICES PO, so a 2-way match applies and the absent goods receipt is not a defect (clause 1). The invoice carries a distinct service period (2026-02-15/2026-03-14) versus the prior paid invoice HL-3301 (2026-02-01/2026-02-28), and the billed name does not normalise to the prior name, so clause 8's conditions are not all met — this is a legitimate recurring charge under clause 8.1, not a duplicate. Unit price equals the PO price (clause 3), tax of $300.00 matches 7.5% of the $4,000.00 net exactly (clause 5), and no credit memos are open (clause 9). Net payable $4,300.00 requires AP_CLERK approval (clause 10).
